name: Tarazoo
tagline: Barcode-free camera checkout for shoppers plus automated catalog, inventory, forecasting and procurement for merchants.
problem: Checkout and merchant back-office work are slow and manual.
solution: Shoppers point a camera at an item to add it to a cart; merchants get catalog editing, sales tracking, demand forecasting and procurement optimized with mixed-integer programming.
demo_moment: Team-described: point the camera at an item and it lands in the cart.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Shopify: Hack Shopping with AI” among 261 submissions.
Uses real optimization for procurement, beyond an LLM.

lessons: Serving both sides of the counter shows a whole business.
